bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical and ethical evaluation of distributive justice and economic fairness, analyzing how AI systems trained on data from lower-income communities often disproportionately benefit wealthier populations while exploiting the original data contributors.

Conceptual analysis of representational and power fairness, examining how marginalized and underrepresented communities face 'manufactured consent' and bear disproportionate surveillance and privacy risks due to institutional power imbalances.
